scope: Existing Saints W49 ordered categories 1-50 only; source-based human 5-star selection and same-object reproduction curation
rules: Show only recorded human-five-star paintings for a category that has one or more valid 5★ subject assignments.
When multiple 5★ paintings exist, show only those selected works and their photographed image versions.
When no 5★ exists, show non-approved painting candidates; do not pretend there are 4-5 where evidence is absent.
Different pixels derived by resizing a single file are NOT separate image versions; list distinct Commons files / independent photos only.
Human 5★ painting ratings are locked; user reviews the specific reproduction choice, or rates a new no-five painting.
Known misidentified historical image previews are blocked and retained as photograph-quality holds; never display the wrong photograph as selected art.
Original files are external references, not yet fetched and hashed into local production; linked Commons rights vary by file; museum page alone is not an open licence.
Permanent rejected paintings 0–2 and excluded artists remain excluded.
Do not touch production, calendar precedence or owners' original human-rating ledgers.
